lineChart.alt: SPY hourly line for 2026-06-01, 09:30 to 16:00 ET. Gold marks profitable trades and blue losing trades, only between supplied entry and exit times. Color shows the completed trade outcome, not running profit, price direction, or execution quality. Breakeven, unknown outcomes, conflicting overlapping trades, and time outside supplied trades stay neutral. Boundaries clip the displayed line; they do not add price observations. Partial coverage: Webull timed trades; Schwab timing unavailable. Uncoloured time means this record is incomplete there, not that no trading happened.

lineChart.gapNote: The line joins the session open and each hourly bar’s close — eight points in all. Bar timestamps mark interval starts; the final interval ends at 16:00 ET. No interpolation between them and no minute-level price path. Trade colors use only supplied times and outcomes.
notes: A thin line connects the session open and each hourly bar’s close, in the order they were observed. Height is scaled to this session.
